description:
Regenerate both the Read and Write API keys for the Emoncms admin account. You are logged in as admin. 

1. Navigate to My Account.
2. Regenerate the Write API key.
3. Regenerate the Read API key.
4. Save the NEW keys to a file named '/home/ga/new_apikeys.txt' in the following format:
   WRITE_KEY=<new_write_key>
   READ_KEY=<new_read_key>

Ensure the old keys (provided in /tmp/old_apikeys.txt for reference) are no longer valid.
